_readme: Every AdSense unit the site uses, one per placement. A new ad spot gets its own named unit in AdSense (Ads, By ad unit, Display ads) before it goes live, and its id goes here in the same commit. check-adsense fails on a slot that is not here, on a slot outside the pages listed for it, and on a live unit it cannot find. 'where' is a page, or a folder ending in /. 'planned' is made in AdSense but not built yet. 'many' lets one page carry several of that unit (the guides).
